sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Reject: the unknown-torque branch still only requires presence of maximumEngineTorque and does not establish that its quantity is the value selected from TRAFICOM Table 6-10. Preserve the ship-to-tableLookupCase path, lookup evidence, tableReference value, datatype, and kN*m unit, and add a canonical table-selection/result relationship or registered bounded table-lookup constraint binding the selected Table 6-10 result to ship.maximumEngineTorque. Do not let the true branch pass merely through an unsubstantiated maximumEngineTorqueKnown flag where applicability evidence requires support.
